dns_guide.intro: Setting up the popular Xbox DNS service (xbox-dns.ru) on Windows to bypass blocks and get stable access to services, games, and AI tools.

win11.title: 🖥️ For Windows 11 (via DoH)
win11.desc: Recommended method for the latest Windows versions. Uses DNS-over-HTTPS encryption.
steps: Open 'Settings' -> 'Network & Internet' -> 'Wi-Fi' or 'Ethernet'.
Click 'Hardware properties'.
In the 'DNS server assignment' section, click 'Edit'.
Select 'Manual', enable IPv4, and enter 111.88.96.50 and 111.88.96.51.
In the 'Preferred DNS encryption' menu, select 'Encrypted only (DNS over HTTPS)'. Enter https://xbox-dns.ru/dns-query
Save changes.

win10.title: ⚙️ Standard Method (Windows 10 and older)
win10.desc: Classic method for setting up unencrypted DNS servers via Control Panel.
steps: Open 'Control Panel' -> 'Network and Sharing Center'.
Click your active connection (e.g., 'Ethernet' or 'Wi-Fi').
Click 'Properties'.
Select 'Internet Protocol Version 4 (TCP/IPv4)' and click 'Properties'.
Select 'Use the following DNS server addresses' and enter: 111.88.96.50 and 111.88.96.51.
Click OK and restart your browser.

browser.title: 🌐 Browser-only Setup
browser.desc: This method enables bypassing only for the browser (Chrome, Edge, Yandex, Opera) without affecting other programs.
steps: Open browser settings and navigate to 'Security' (or 'Privacy and Security').
Find the 'Use secure DNS' option.
Enable it and select 'With custom provider'.
Enter: https://xbox-dns.ru/dns-query

zapret_guide.intro: Zapret (Flowseal build) is a popular utility for bypassing DPI blocks on Discord, YouTube, and other services on Windows. It intercepts and modifies traffic using WinDivert.

download.title: 📥 1. Download & Preparation
steps: Download the latest release from the link below.
Extract the archive to a folder without spaces or non-English characters in the path (e.g. C:\zapret).

run.title: 🚀 2. How to Run
run.desc: Inside the extracted folder, there are multiple files to launch:
run.general: Any file starting with general (e.g. general ALT.bat). Starts the bypass manually. Try them one by one until you find the one that works best for you.
run.service: Utility to install the bypass as a Windows service (autorun). Run it, select 'Install Service' and pick a strategy to keep it running in the background.
run.note: If Discord or YouTube are still not working, make sure to try running a different general file (another 'strategy').

hosts_guide.intro: The hosts file is a Windows system text file that overrides DNS and directly maps a domain to an IP address. This helps bypass basic DNS-level blocking and directs traffic through working servers.

how_it_works.title: ⚙️ 1. How it works
how_it_works.desc: Normally, your browser asks the DNS server: 'Where is youtube.com?', and the ISP can fake the answer or block it. If the site is listed in the hosts file, the browser takes the IP address directly from there, ignoring the ISP block.

Save the changes.

download.title: 📥 1. Download & Install
steps: Go to the official website using the link below.
Select your operating system and download the installer.
Install the program following the standard on-screen instructions.

setup.title: 🚀 2. Activation
steps: Launch the application after installation.
